subject: Execute deterministic API-grounded Westside homepage
body: Build the real editable 1440x1200 Westside Watch homepage board using the deterministic official Penpot Plugin API construction now embedded in penpot_agent.py. Return the exact board id and export that exact board as PNG for visual verification. Do not create probes or placeholders.
task: Create 02 — Westside Watch Homepage v0.1 — API Grounded as a real editable 1440x1200 Penpot board using official APIs only, then export the exact board as PNG and verify it visually.
design_brief: Living Paper #FAF9F5; Ink #252525; First Light Gold #A2872A; Watch Night #102A43; Morning Gold #D2BC69.
